VERSION 3.28.0.164

; Optional PaperHid pointer controls in Settings > Help. This is deliberately
; independent from MainView and the cursor FIFO patch. Every command and
; argument is fixed at parse time and routes through an allow-listed script.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Help.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0

    ; Make this a real ColumnLayout child rather than an overlay in itemWrapper:
    ; the stock layout then reserves vertical space for the controls and support
    ; text, so varying Help widgets cannot overlap the PaperHid buttons.
    TRAVERSE Background#root > ScrollArea#flickable > Item#itemWrapper > ColumnLayout#column
        LOCATE BEFORE ArkControls.Body#supportText
        INSERT {
            ColumnLayout {
                id: paperPointerSettingsRoot
                objectName: "paperpointer-settings-root"
                spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium
                Layout.fillWidth: true

                property string actionStatus: qsTr("Ready")

                ArkControls.Body {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    text: qsTr("PaperHid pointer")
                }

                ArkControls.Body {
                    id: paperPointerStatusText
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    text: paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus
                }

                RowLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                        text: qsTr("Keep cursor visible")
                        enabled: !paperPointerStickyCommand.running
                        onClicked: {
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus = qsTr("Applying...");
                            paperPointerStickyCommand.startCommand(100);
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                        text: qsTr("Hide after 3 seconds")
                        enabled: !paperPointerHideCommand.running
                        onClicked: {
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus = qsTr("Applying...");
                            paperPointerHideCommand.startCommand(100);
                        }
                    }
                }

                RowLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                        text: qsTr("Crosshair cursor")
                        enabled: !paperPointerStyleCrossCommand.running
                        onClicked: {
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus = qsTr("Applying...");
                            paperPointerStyleCrossCommand.startCommand(100);
                        }
                    }

                    ArkControls.Button {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        type: ArkTokens.Button.secondary
                        text: qsTr("Win95 cursor")
                        enabled: !paperPointerStyleWin95Command.running
                        onClicked: {
                            paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus = qsTr("Applying...");
                            paperPointerStyleWin95Command.startCommand(100);
                        }
                    }
                }

                XoviMessageBroker {
                    listeningFor: ["paperpointer.settings.ping"]

                    function onSignalReceived(signal, message) {
                        if (signal === "paperpointer.settings.ping")
                            return "paperpointer-settings-qml-3.28.0.164";
                        return "";
                    }
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperPointerStatusCommand
                    command: "/home/root/.paperpointer/ui-actions/status.sh"
                    arguments: []

                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) {
                        paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus = output.trim();
                    }
                    Component.onCompleted: startCommand(100)
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperPointerStickyCommand
                    command: "/home/root/.paperpointer/ui-actions/set-hide-ms.sh"
                    arguments: ["0"]
                    property bool launched: false

                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) {
                        paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus = output.trim();
                    }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (running) {
                            launched = true;
                        } else if (launched) {
                            launched = false;
                            paperPointerStatusCommand.startCommand(100);
                        }
                    }
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperPointerHideCommand
                    command: "/home/root/.paperpointer/ui-actions/set-hide-ms.sh"
                    arguments: ["3000"]
                    property bool launched: false

                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) {
                        paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus = output.trim();
                    }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (running) {
                            launched = true;
                        } else if (launched) {
                            launched = false;
                            paperPointerStatusCommand.startCommand(100);
                        }
                    }
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperPointerStyleCrossCommand
                    command: "/home/root/.paperpointer/ui-actions/set-cursor-style.sh"
                    arguments: ["cross"]
                    property bool launched: false

                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) {
                        paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus = output.trim();
                    }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (running) {
                            launched = true;
                        } else if (launched) {
                            launched = false;
                            paperPointerStatusCommand.startCommand(100);
                        }
                    }
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperPointerStyleWin95Command
                    command: "/home/root/.paperpointer/ui-actions/set-cursor-style.sh"
                    arguments: ["win95"]
                    property bool launched: false

                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) {
                        paperPointerSettingsRoot.actionStatus = output.trim();
                    }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (running) {
                            launched = true;
                        } else if (launched) {
                            launched = false;
                            paperPointerStatusCommand.startCommand(100);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
